scope: A1 Markdown/HTML image labels and URI paths; not complete ecosystem or save-options acceptance

contract.labels: Reuse link-label punctuation escaping; CR/LF/TAB represented with character references. Literal label text remains one image, without extra links or raw HTML nodes.
contract.paths: Physical filenames and image bytes unchanged. Relative paths use forward slashes; filename and filesystem path characters URI encoded, including literal percent signs.
contract.alias: String URL prefix with no raw ASCII controls. Append encoded filename to path, preserving existing escaped percent sequences in prefix and original query/fragment. Literal path #/? in alias must be percent encoded. URL parsing errors fail before creating assets.
contract.mime: When image_type supplies no MIME, use existing Pillow header recognition for inline rasters. No image reencoding or source-model mutation. Unsupported unrecognized inline data is omitted with a content-loss diagnostic.
contract.unsafe: Markdown and HTML image scheme allowlist; dangerous linked sources omitted with ContentLossWarning. Strict failure rolls back newly published images and retains existing files.
contract.direct: Direct writer without output path and with absolute image folder emits file URI. Public external-image in-memory output remains rejected.

import hashlib,json,sys,warnings,subprocess
from io import BytesIO
from pathlib import Path
from docx import Document as NativeDocument
from markdown_it import MarkdownIt
from PIL import Image
import aspose.words_foss as aw
assert 'site-packages' in aw.__file__,aw.__file__
parser=MarkdownIt('commonmark').enable('table');parser.validateLink=lambda target:True
root=Path('/tmp/docweave-current-performance');records=[]
for name in ('small','hundred_pages','image_table','repeated_images','mixed_styles'):
 with warnings.catch_warnings():
  warnings.simplefilter('ignore');doc=aw.Document(root/(name+'.docx'));raw=doc.to_bytes('md').decode()
 pandoc_html=subprocess.run(['/tmp/docweave-pandoc-arm64/pandoc','--from=commonmark+pipe_tables','--to=html'],input=raw,text=True,capture_output=True,check=True).stdout
 tokens=[child for token in parser.parse(raw) for child in token.children or []]
 semantics=[(t.attrGet('src'),''.join(c.content for c in t.children or [])) for t in tokens if t.type=='image']
 records.append({'independent_image_semantics_sha256':hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(semantics,ensure_ascii=False).encode()).hexdigest(),'image_count':len(semantics),'pandoc_html_sha256':hashlib.sha256(pandoc_html.encode()).hexdigest(),'name':name,'source_sha256':hashlib.sha256((root/(name+'.docx')).read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'markdown_bytes':len(raw.encode()),'markdown_sha256':hashlib.sha256(raw.encode()).hexdigest(),'independent_html_sha256':hashlib.sha256(parser.render(raw).encode()).hexdigest(),'diagnostic_codes':[d.code for d in doc.diagnostics]})
proof=Path('/tmp/docweave-image-links-proof');proof.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
source=proof/'source.docx';alt='Alt ](https://evil.invalid) <script>x</script> ![label'
if not source.exists():
 pic=BytesIO();Image.new('RGB',(3,3),'blue').save(pic,format='PNG')
 native=NativeDocument();inline=native.add_paragraph().add_run().add_picture(BytesIO(pic.getvalue()))._inline;inline.docPr.set('descr',alt);native.save(source)
raw=aw.Document(source).to_bytes('md').decode();roots=parser.parse(raw);tokens=roots+[c for t in roots for c in (t.children or [])]
pandoc_alt_html=subprocess.run(['/tmp/docweave-pandoc-arm64/pandoc','--from=commonmark+pipe_tables','--to=html'],input=raw,text=True,capture_output=True,check=True).stdout
from xml.etree import ElementTree as ET
try:
 pandoc_alt=ET.fromstring('<root>'+pandoc_alt_html+'</root>').find('.//img').get('alt')
except ET.ParseError:
 pandoc_alt=None
result={'pandoc_real_alt':pandoc_alt,'module':aw.__file__,'records':records,'real_docx_alt_probe':{'source_sha256':hashlib.sha256(source.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'images':sum(t.type=='image' for t in tokens),'raw_html_nodes':sum(t.type in ('html_inline','html_block') for t in tokens),'image_alts':[''.join(c.content for c in t.children) for t in tokens if t.type=='image'],'markdown':raw}}
Path(sys.argv[1]).write_text(json.dumps(result,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps(result['real_docx_alt_probe'],ensure_ascii=False))

import hashlib,json,sys
from pathlib import Path
import pymupdf
import aspose.words_foss as aw
assert 'site-packages' in aw.__file__,aw.__file__
root=Path('/tmp/docweave-current-performance');results={}
for case in ('small','hundred_pages','image_table','repeated_images','mixed_styles'):
 raw=aw.Document(root/(case+'.docx')).to_bytes(aw.saving.PdfSaveOptions())
 pages=[]
 with pymupdf.open(stream=raw,filetype='pdf') as pdf:
  for page in pdf:
   pages.append({key:hashlib.sha256(value).hexdigest() for key,value in {'words':repr(page.get_text('words')).encode(),'pixels':page.get_pixmap().samples,'drawings':repr(page.get_drawings()).encode(),'images':repr(page.get_image_info()).encode()}.items()})
 results[case]={'bytes':len(raw),'pages':pages}
Path(sys.argv[1]).write_text(json.dumps(results,indent=2)+'\n');print('five PDF corpora saved')
